name: Cog
note: The northern workhorse. One mast, a broad hold, and nothing clever about her. What the house already sails.

name: Carrack
note: Twice the hold, and a fifth again the time to get anywhere. Her hold only earns its keep where a single consignment has to move at once — a delivery somebody is waiting on, or a market deep enough to take the lot. For ordinary buying and selling a cog will beat her, and cost less to keep.

name: Galley
note: Oars as well as sail. Small, dear, and quick — she is for being somewhere before the news is, not for carrying much once you are.

name: Courier
note: A rider and a remount, not a hull. Carries nothing but word, and travels by land only — which is often the faster road.
